 Gorakhpur Weather: Rain & Strong Winds Expected | Temperature Drops
 Cyclonic storm to affect Gorakhpur: Rain likely with strong winds, temperature set to drop
 Abhijeet Singh | Gorakhpur 3 days ago 
 Copy link 
 The weather in Gorakhpur has gradually begun to change. There is a growing chill in the mornings and evenings, while strong sunshine during the day is making it feel warm. The sky has been clear since Tuesday morning, with bright sunshine.
 Temperatures have begun to fall, making the weather cooler in the mornings and at night. According to the Meteorological Department, the maximum temperature on Tuesday is expected to be 31°C, while the minimum temperature is likely to be 18°C.
 The weather in Gorakhpur may begin to change from Wednesday. According to meteorologists, the influence of a western disturbance could bring cloudy skies and rain. Fluctuations in the weather may be seen over the next three days.
 Rain is expected to bring down daytime and night-time temperatures. This could lead to increased cold in the mornings and evenings. However, it is important to keep an eye on the Meteorological Department's latest forecast to know when and how much rain is likely.
 Weather likely to change due to Cyclonic Storm 'Ornav' 
 The cyclonic storm 'Ornaw', which has formed over the Bay of Bengal, is expected to affect the weather in eastern Uttar Pradesh. Under its influence, Gorakhpur and neighbouring districts may experience strong winds and rain.
 According to Gautam Gupta, district disaster expert with the District Disaster Management Authority, the storm is likely to affect eastern Uttar Pradesh on 29 and 30 October.
 Likely to make landfall on 28 October 
 District disaster expert Gautam Gupta said the cyclonic storm is likely to make landfall on 28 October. Its impact may then be felt in eastern Uttar Pradesh on 29 and 30 October.
 Strong winds and rain are expected during this period. However, the actual impact of the storm in Gorakhpur and the intensity of the rain will depend on the weather conditions and the latest forecast issued by the department.
 Keep an eye on weather department updates 
 People need to remain alert in view of the possible change in the weather. In the event of strong winds or rain, they should avoid standing near trees, electricity poles and weak structures.
 People should keep an eye on alerts issued by the Meteorological Department and the district administration. For now, bright sunshine is forecast during the day on Tuesday, while the cold may intensify in the morning and evening.
